prompt:
Some people think it is better to stay with the same employer for most of one's working life. Others believe that changing jobs every few years is more useful.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both ways of working should be presented with their own reasons
Benefits of staying with the same employer: in-depth knowledge, trust, promotion, job security
Benefits of changing jobs: new skills, a broader outlook, improved pay and conditions
One's own opinion should be clear, and it can be qualified according to the type of career
Examples should be general; real company or personal names should not be used
common_mistakes: Describing only one's own personal plan instead of discussing both views
Stating no preference at all for the sake of appearing balanced
Repeating the same idea in two paragraphs with different words
